name: arduino-app-lab-ai-runtime-opencode
description: Pinned AI agent runtime packages for Arduino App Lab (OpenCode agent). Installed with `npm ci` into a per-user app-data runtime directory by internal/airuntime. OpenCode ships a native per-platform binary as an optional dependency, so npm installs only the host's; Node is needed to install, not to run. Versions are pinned EXACTLY (no ^/~/latest) and bumped deliberately — see internal/airuntime/VERSIONING.md.
